sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Heart, Male v1.3
3D Reference Organ for Blood Vasculature, Male v1.3
sources.used: 25 of 87 vessel meshes (aortic root and arch with branch stumps, pulmonary trunk/arteries/veins, venae cavae, coronary arteries with marginal branches, coronary sinus and cardiac veins)

files.attribution: Heart and great vessels: "3D Reference Organ for Heart, Male v1.3" (https://doi.org/10.48539/HBM564.WKNG.249) and "3D Reference Organ for Blood Vasculature, Male v1.3" by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein, Human Reference Atlas / NIH HuBMAP, made from the Visible Human Male (National Library of Medicine); licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Modified by Bilig: subset of vessels, renamed parts, simplified, recoloured, section caps and schematic pericardium added.
modifications: kept the 14 heart meshes and 25 great-vessel and coronary meshes around the heart from the vasculature model (same Visible Human Male frame, no fitting)

renamed nodes to the topic concept masks: RightAtrium, LeftAtrium, RightVentricle, LeftVentricle, Valve_{Tricuspid,Mitral,Aortic,Pulmonary}, Aorta_* (ascending, arch, descending, branch stumps); papillary muscles became children of their ventricle; septum, pulmonary vessels, venae cavae, Coronary_* and CardiacVein_* are named but not bound to a concept
added a schematic pericardium (PCA-fitted ellipsoid around the chambers; not in the source) as the isContainer shell
baked node transforms, centred on the chambers and scaled ×27.37 (metres → scene units, heart ≈ 3.4 units)

replaced materials with an atlas palette: red-brown myocardium, arteries red, venae cavae and cardiac veins blue-purple, pulmonary arteries blue, pulmonary veins red, cream valves; clearcoat (KHR_materials_clearcoat) for a wet serous surface
painted vertex colours on the chamber walls: subepicardial groove fat (yellow) along the coronary vessels and a faint muscle mottling
added flat section caps where the client's section plane (z = 0) cuts the closed walls and vessels, so the cut myocardium reads as solid tissue (generated from the simplified surface)

dropped source vertex colours/UVs and duplicate triangles; per-part meshoptimizer simplification (chambers 0.5–0.8, valves 0.3, vessels 0.3–0.6 of the source triangles, error 0.0015); gltf-transform dedup, prune, weld, EXT_meshopt_compression + quantisation
